statements.text: Primary aromatic amines react with $\mathrm{HNO2}$ to form diazonium salts which are stable even above $300\,\mathrm{K}$.

options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

b6_reason: Aliphatic diazonium salts are indeed unstable, but aryl diazonium salts are only stable near 273-278 K and decompose above that, so Statement II is wrong.
